requirements.description: Fellowships are provided to excellent researchers undertaking international mobility; excellence and international mobility are the defining scope criteria of the instrument.
Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary in the academic or non-academic sector.
European Postdoctoral Fellowships must take place in an EU Member State or a Horizon Europe Associated Country; open to researchers of any nationality wishing to come to Europe or move within Europe.

Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are for European nationals or long-term residents and require an outgoing phase in a non-associated Third Country followed by a mandatory 12-month return phase to a host in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country.

Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences common to all fields, including digital ones (e.g. generative AI), and foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation, innovation, entrepreneurship, and good scientific conduct.

Training activities must empower fellows to pursue a research career and prepare them for increased research collaboration and information-sharing via digital technologies (open access, FAIR data, citizen science, societal engagement).

A Career Development Plan encompassing research objectives, training and career needs, transferable skills, teaching, publications, and open science participation must be established jointly by supervisor(s) and the researcher.

Secondments are optional; if included for European Fellowships, they cannot exceed half of the requested fellowship duration (excluding any non-academic placement period) and must add significant value to the fellowship.
Non-academic sector placements are optional; if included, they must be integral to the proposal with explicit justification of added value for the project and for the researcher's career development.

requirements.description: ERA Fellowships (Work Programme Annex 11) provide specific support for researchers to undertake fellowships in widening countries; proposals targeting widening countries may access this sub-scheme.
Euratom research areas are within scope for MSCA-PF; specific eligibility conditions apply and Euratom contributes an indicative EUR 1 million per year to the call.
